profile.headline: Software Engineer | API Integrations | Software Compliance | SECS/GEM Equipment Integration (SEMI E30/E5/E37) | Semiconductor Factory Automation | C# · Hume SDK
profile.summary:
Software engineer specializing in SECS/GEM equipment communication for high-tech and semiconductor manufacturing. At Nordson Corporation, I develop and maintain the C# SECS/GEM application  — that connects our equipment to customers' factory automation lines.
Day to day, I work directly with customers to tailor our equipment's SECS/GEM behavior to their host and automation systems: adding and configuring data points and GEM collection events for reporting, and keeping our products compliant with SEMI software standards. I also consult with new customers on the SECS/GEM capabilities of our equipment and how they're typically deployed on the line.

I hold a B.S. in Computer Science from California State University San Marcos. I'm at my best translating complex equipment-integration problems into clear solutions for both engineers and non-technical manufacturing staff — minimizing downtime and getting tools online faster.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
● Develop and maintain the C# SECS/GEM application (Hume SDK) interfacing Nordson equipment with customers' factory automation and host systems.
● Work directly with customers to modify equipment SECS/GEM behavior (E30/E5/E37) for clean integration with their automation lines.
● Add and configure new GEM data points, variables, and collection events to meet customer reporting requirements.
● Consult with new customers on available SECS/GEM equipment options and typical production-line deployment.
● Maintain SEMI software compliance on an industry-leading product.
● Troubleshoot host–equipment communication issues in real time, frequently resolving them without code changes to reduce downtime.
positions.insights: Windows Presentation Foundation (WPF), C# and +3 skills

positions.title: Software Test Engineer
positions.description:
- Create and execute test plans to validate the functionality of new features and conduct explorative testing to test edge case behaviors proactively. 
- Create automated python test cases, TCL Scripts, and execute regression test cases to ensure software requirements are maintained.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
● I am tasked with designing the software solutions for manufacturer testing devices, this includes UI/UX, database
management, testing logic, and interfaces for the supporting hardware (i.e pressure sensors).
● The devices we produce are created on a per client basis and require an understanding of client needs and expectations.
● Technologies we implemented in the most recent project include, React, React Hooks, node.js, dequalize, redux, python,
websockets, raspberry pi GPIO, json, xState.

positions.title: Student Technology aid
positions.description:
I aided in setup and maintenance of classroom technological solutions. Including A/V systems and end user software assistance. 

My stay at this site was cut short due to COVID-19, I did assist in the emergency deployment of over 500 Laptops for students as the campus transitioned to online teaching.

positions.title: Advanced Repair agent
positions.description:
offered technological solutions and recommendations to consumer end users. Assisted in repair, setup and maintenance of new and used devices.

Tracked productivity via a standardized ticket system, and was also responsible for inventory and end user data privacy protection.
Agent: 133921

projects.title: Spectrogram analysis for liveness detection - Published by IEEE
projects.description:
I wrote a paper discussing a novel approach on liveness detection for voice based assistants such as Amazon Alexa.
This paper was published at IEEE AIIot, where I presented and received best presenter award for my group.

I was introduced and guided in the project by Ph.D professor Yan Yan Li. https://faculty.csusm.edu/yali/index.html

I analyzed a potential security breach in voice activated assistants, discussed possible threats to these devices. I then created a solution to this via machine learning spectrogram voice analysis.

I documented my methods and results, along with a video demonstration to accompany it.
